name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: each sentence commands a single unconditional event with no preference cue — 'Get into the locked room' maps to the hard Existence(target_room_entered) and 'Pick up the ball' to the hard Existence(target_picked_up). The two sentences are independent points (no order word such as 'then' or 'after' links them), so no Precedence clause is needed and none is added. Both propositions are correctly grounded, both goals are hard, the machine has a final state reached when both occur, and no clause repeats what another forces.

texts: The agent must get into the locked room at least once.
The agent must pick up the mission's target ball at least once.
